risks.check: All four groups retain the original C1 reclaim signal_date; no C2/C3 later confirmation date becomes entry time.
Support and dual-MA state carry source/confirmation dates no later than the C1 signal date; engine itself does not enforce this.
Target source and confirmation predate or equal signal date and use then-current units; missing target is not filled from future bars.
New groups explicitly choose acceptance and sizing; old engine config_id branches must not accidentally impose ACD 3R/1% rules or diagnostic target bypass.
Next-open planning uses the candidate ETF's quote calendar, not a union calendar if products share an account.
Open availability uses only open, prior known close, effective action and dated restriction; same-day high/low/close are unavailable.
Structure failure, target and black-state precedence and trigger price are fixed before returns; strict comparisons and next allowed open are verified.
Entry-day levels already use current units; later dividend/split actions transform stop/target once, while record/ex/pay rights remain distinct.
At each decision date only outcomes resolved earlier are visible; unresolved paths remain explicit and never enter win/loss statistics.
When exit variants have different durations, any comparison used for selection uses the same pre-fixed mature historical opportunity cohort.
